content.body:
Facing the rapid introduction of the semi-automatic rifles of the United States and the U.S.S.R - the M1 Garand and the Tokarev SVT-40, respectively - Germany sought out an answer. The Walther-designed G41(W) won and became the Gewehr 43.
More difficult to produce, it was not issued in quantities approaching its rivals but over 400,000 were issued by the end of the war.
